prose: CORRECTS ideas/2026-11-14-a-device-whose-loaded-code-predates-the.json, whose diagnosis was wrong (nothing was stale). Measured 2026-11-14: akienasus has no bus of its own (CAIRN_BUS_HOME=akiendelllinux.local:7419), so skills/sorted/door.py's reason_has_referent(reason, repo=_REPO, commons=_COMMONS) is answered by the Dell's codemother over inspect. The caller's repo=/home/akien/cairn and commons=/home/akien/CairnCommons do not exist on the Dell (its repo is /home/akien/dev/src/cairn), so the judge resolves every path referent against a missing tree and answers False. With the Dell's paths the same remote ask answers True; with no kwargs it answers True (codemother's own repo). Effect: every /sorted cast from a box that is not the bus host is refused on any 'none, because <path>' field. A box-local Path crosses the wire as if it named the same place on the answering box.
